evidence_notice: No biological conductance, unitary effect, or delay is measured by this model. Every electrical number/effect below is an ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION, predeclared before simulation; this is a falsifiable engineering reference, not a literal larval circuit.

chemical_effects.basis: Fixed scale chosen before circuit simulation: 20 contacts correspond to 1 mV-equivalent, equal to the generic LIF threshold. This is a transparent scale convention, not observed efficacy.
